Preserved original preload/protocol identity diagnostic. DesktopRoot.tsx catches bridge/context failure and renders shell.windowUnconfirmed plus shell.keepWindow; invalid native identity never falls back to Web or renders this raw string. ProjectEntry uses its own outcome descriptors for later open failures.

Preserved original editor-role invariant Error.message. Its displayMessage is shell.error.editorProject; App.readableError forwards that descriptor to the boot/error presentation without changing native role contracts.

Preserved original exact-create-ACK diagnostic in the legacy native input validator. Current App.jsx routes native creation immediately to ProjectEntry; its createLauncherClient validates the same name/description and project-entry-state.ts renders projects.createUnknownRefresh on a mismatched ACK while retaining the original create latch. The original diagnostic is not current GUI copy.

Preserved LastProjectRequestError diagnostic. last-project-state.ts classifies by stable code/status/kind and exposes phase/uncertain/identityBlocked; LastProjectStatus.tsx renders projects.locatorUnconfirmed, projects.locatorUncertain or projects.locatorIdentityChanged. NativeLocatorStatus.tsx renders projects.locatorUnconfirmed from the retained owner status, never raw Error.message.
